title: Signup accepts a weak password
description: The signup backend checks whether passwords match but does not enforce a minimum password length or strength.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter a new valid email address
Enter a very short password in both password fields
expected: The app should reject passwords that do not meet its password policy.
actual: The backend accepts the password if both password fields match.

title: Contact form accepts an empty message
description: The contact backend does not reject empty names or messages.
expected: The app should reject an empty message and ask the user to enter one.
actual: The backend stores the empty message and returns a success response.

title: Dashboard access depends on a query parameter
description: The dashboard identifies the user through an email query parameter instead of a verified login session.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the dashboard URL using that account's email query parameter
Try accessing the dashboard without a verified login session
expected: The dashboard should require a verified authenticated session.
actual: The route looks up a user based on the email query parameter.

title: Password reset does not actually reset the password
description: The reset endpoint returns a response message but does not update the user's password or send reset instructions.
steps_to_reproduce: Try logging in with a new password
expected: A secure password reset flow should allow the user to change their password.
actual: The endpoint only returns a response message.
